references.why: the look: shaded-relief maps with a year counter, cut-out portraits laid on the map with a serif name label, period paintings, 22 to 24 chronological chapters
the script engine: dated cold open, stakes stacked as numbers, pivot to one central question by about 2:30, 155 to 175 wpm

format.opening: Cold open on one dated, concrete moment (a day, a place, what happened). Within the first 120 words at least one number or date. Then the stakes, then one sentence that turns to the central question.
structure: close with what changed and a question for the comments

visual.base: shaded-relief map, warm paper sea, year counter top right
visual.people: cut-out portrait on the map with a small-caps serif name label
visual.art: period paintings and archival photographs, held or pushed very slowly

format.thumbnail: portrait cut-out on the left, glowing map, 2 to 3 words in gold serif capitals
